content: MDN identifies Pointer Events as the unified mouse, touch, and pen model. Compatibility mouse events can follow pointer events, browser pan/zoom may trigger pointercancel, and pointer capture preserves delivery when contact moves. A one-button game should route pointerdown and keyboard through one guarded action, use touch-action on the game surface, prevent defaults where appropriate, ignore repeats/multi-touch duplicates, and clear state on pointercancel.
